disambiguation: Not a general task manager; it uses a specific Matter/Action structure tied to Kanban and timeline views.
extras: Requires the Bases core plugin to enable board, list, calendar, and timeline views. Supports CLI and AI assistant integration.
intentEvidence: Four views of the same notes. Board, list, calendar and timeline are Bases views, so they live in a .base file next to your other bases and respect its filters.
problem: It addresses the need for a structured, visual way to manage complex projects and daily tasks within the existing note-taking environment of Obsidian.

relations.evidence: The Bases core plugin turned on (Settings → Core plugins → Bases).

summary: A project management plugin that allows users to plan work using Kanban boards, lists, calendars, and timelines, where projects (Matters) and tasks (Actions) are standard notes.
